context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated on https://micro-moments-8.preview.emergentagent.com. UFO Beans popup now uses extracted assets (/case-assets/ufo-beans/extracted/image-p1-1.jpeg and image-p2-1.png), contains campaign pillars + detailed proposition/audience/big idea/problem/strategy/execution content, has zero case-popup-original-image-* elements, background scroll stays locked while popup open, popup content scrolls, and mobile viewport (390x844) has no horizontal overflow.
rca of the issue: Prior mismatch likely came from legacy originalImages/PDF-frame gallery rendering and insufficient background scroll lock.
